segments.name: Fitness — India
segments.description: The full reachable fitness audience in India for English-language short-form content. Root node of the graph; not targeted directly.
segments.rationale: Root niche derived directly from the creator's stated niche and location.

segments.name: Beginner Natural Lifters
segments.description: 0–12 months of consistent training, drug-free by conviction, actively looking for a routine they can trust. Highly suspicious of anyone who looks enhanced.
segments.rationale: Direct match for the creator's stated primary audience and goal of increasing beginner reach.

segments.name: College Gym Starters
segments.description: 18–22, first six months in a campus or budget gym. Motivated by appearance and peer comparison more than by performance. Short attention, heavy share behaviour inside friend groups.
characteristics: very high share rate within close groups
segments.rationale: Matches the creator's stated secondary audience; also the strongest propagation vector into the primary segment.

segments.name: Budget Home Trainees
segments.description: Training at home with minimal equipment because of cost or gym access. Filter out anything that assumes a full commercial gym.
characteristics: high save rate, low share rate
segments.rationale: Adjacent sub-niche discovered from the location signal; commonly reached by spillover rather than by targeting.
